title: RL Flappy Bird
description: A reinforcement learning agent that learns to play Flappy Bird autonomously — game, neural networks, and training loops all running in the browser with TensorFlow.js and Phaser 3. Spans value-based (DQN) and policy-based (REINFORCE, Actor-Critic, PPO) methods.
tagline: The agent is learning. The project is learning with it.
author: danrosselli
